bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, police caught a youth who stole twenty-one batteries from four locations using CCTV footage, and the office should monitor local crime prevention measures.
Mayor Priya accused TVK members of using AI technology to create a vulgar video of her, and the portfolio team should watch for misuse of AI in politics.

stories.title: Tiruvallur | 21 பேட்டரிகளை அபேஸ் செய்த இளைஞர்.. CCTV மூலம் தட்டித் தூக்கிய போலீஸ்
takeaways: Thiruvallur police arrested a youth who stole 21 batteries worth two lakh rupees from various locations.
Law enforcement successfully utilized surveillance footage to track down and apprehend the suspect swiftly.

stories.title: Mayor Priya | "AI தொழில்நுட்பம் மூலம் வக்கிர வீடியோ" தவெகவினர் மீது மேயர் பிரியா பகீர் குற்றச்சாட்டு
takeaways: Mayor Priya accused TVK members of generating a malicious deepfake video using artificial intelligence tools.
The allegation directly implicates the governing party's handling of AI and requires an immediate political response.
